election._note: Open-list national PR (Sainte-Lague) with a 5% threshold for the 100 general seats; 20 are reserved for the non-majority communities (10 Serb, 10 others) -- the reservation unmodelled, read as national PR. The February 2025 election left the Assembly unable to constitute itself for months and a snap election followed on 28 December 2025; the next falls due by late 2029. Seat shares in data/parties/XKX.json are the February 2025 result, the last one this register measured. Constitution of Kosovo, Arts. 64, 66; Wikipedia, '2025 Kosovan parliamentary elections'.

dissolution._note: The Assembly dissolves by a two-thirds vote of its own, or is dissolved by the President when no government is elected or after a successful no-confidence vote (Art. 82) -- self_dissolution read as the template's nearest rule, the presidential route recorded here. Constitution of Kosovo, Art. 82.

head_of_state._note: The President, elected by the Assembly for five years (two terms at most) with a two-thirds quorum in the first rounds; elected April 2021, so the next falls in spring 2026. Constitution of Kosovo, Arts. 86-87.
head_of_state.title: President

amendment._note: Art. 144: two thirds of all deputies INCLUDING two thirds of the deputies holding the reserved community seats -- a double majority whose community half is unmodelled -- after the Constitutional Court confirms the draft diminishes no right. Constitution of Kosovo, Art. 144.
amendment._referendum_note: No constitutional referendum exists. Constitution of Kosovo, Art. 144.
amendment._permits_system_change_note: No eternity clause beyond the rights catalogue Art. 144(3) protects.

judicial._note: A Constitutional Court reviews the constitutionality of laws and of draft amendments (Arts. 112-118). Constitution of Kosovo, Art. 113.

formation._note: The President nominates the candidate of the largest list or coalition, and the Assembly elects the government by a majority of all deputies (Art. 95). No-confidence needs a majority of all deputies (Art. 100), read as simple_present. Constitution of Kosovo, Arts. 95, 100.

government._pretender_note: Whom data/laws/amendments.json's Restoration Act puts on the throne. Kosovo has never been a monarchy; the restored line is the house's invention, as MLT's is.

fiscal._note: General government, IMF/Ministry of Finance ~2024, rounded, on AUT.json's conventions. VAT 18% standard; corporate 10%; income 10 blends the 0-10% wage schedule toward its top; capital gains 10%; no wealth tax. Revenue ~25% of GDP: Kosovo levies no social contributions (pensions are a funded savings trust plus a basic state pension, hence 3% on the line). Debt ~17% of GDP (end-2024), in euros: Kosovo uses the euro unilaterally and is NOT a eurozone member. Infrastructure 6% is the public-investment programme. Spending scaled to expenditure near 30% of GDP. Kosovo's contested status -- Serbia and five EU members do not recognise it -- has no field here: relations seed structurally (docs/data-sources.md records the bound).
